North American Airlines

Every carrier flying under a North American flag — the three US majors and their regional feeders, the low-cost and ultra-low-cost fleets, Air Canada and WestJet, and the Mexican and Caribbean-facing operators. For each: where it is headquartered, the hubs it actually builds its schedule around, the alliance it credits to, roughly how large the fleet is and what it is genuinely good at, with a link to its own reviews and safety rating.
